title_en: Parton's gift dot lands by the lone stranger
caption_en: Your gift dot lands beside the one stranger's dot you cannot choose; a small crop shows Kusama lending you the way to place one.
You arrive at a wall full of other people's dots and pick where yours goes.
Four faint tries become one crystal, and you read how many tries the real one took.

title_en: The wall goes on without you
caption_en: Your marks have melted into everyone else's; the wall carries on.
The same first look on a night-sky wall.
The same crystal moment on a night-sky wall.

title_en: Kusama's lend line (full size of the crop)
caption_en: Standing at Kusama's statue, you are told it lends you a way to place a dot.
After two wrong pockets the key finally fits and you read how many tries it took her.
You stick your last coloured dots on a blank sheet; used stickers just vanish.

title_en: At the arch, it can only be given
caption_en: You stand holding what you took, and are told you can't keep it.
You hand a small child the book and hear 'for me? thank you'; the inset shows the same child next visit, still holding it.

title_en: The hall, not yet in time
caption_en: Four faint rings pulse out of step in a quiet dark hall.
You press Z as the ring swells and her crystal lattice fills in a little more.
Before pressing, you read what Yonath did.
All four rings finally pulse in step, each in its own colour.
All four rings finally pulse in step, one warm light, told apart only by shape.
Everything stops together and the hall goes quiet.
